test_name: GymBotArea bot spawn click race between clients - 3c4d898e-ff3e-411a-be6b-78e912513b5b
summary: Both clients spawned a bot because the gym area's spawn claim was a plain property write that each client believed straight away. The claim is now an entry in a StringKeyDictionary on the area's model. A client spawns only after the server accepts its insert; the server rejects the second of two concurrent inserts, so the other client gets a rejection and does not spawn. In the GYM level two same-frame inserts came back accepted/rejected, two same-frame Spawn presses produced exactly one bot, and kill-then-respawn still works. The actual two-client simultaneous press was not run: this machine has no Multiplayer Play Mode second player set up. One edge case remains: if the losing client ends up owning the area, the winner's claim is not cleared early and lapses after 3 seconds.
